project_info.name: RPS Grade 4 Programming Homework Portal (2026/2027)

environment_variables.description: Secret key used for signing JWT tokens

ai_activity_logs.author: Antigravity AI
ai_activity_logs.action: Created vibecode-log.json and updated backend auto-migration for Supabase deployment.
ai_activity_logs.issue_diagnosed: Render backend failed on launch with error: 'relation "users" does not exist' because Supabase DB was empty and init.sql was not automatically executed on startup.
changes_made: Created vibecode-log.json in project root directory for context sharing across devices.
Updated backend/index.js initDB() to execute backend/init.sql automatically on startup if tables are missing.
Added auto-seeding in initDB() for admin account (admin/admin123), student accounts, and curriculum topics/questions from CSV.
ai_activity_logs.instructions_for_next_ai: When starting on a new device, check DATABASE_URL environment variable in Render. On deployment, node index.js will execute init.sql to build tables automatically and seed default data. Default admin login is admin/admin123.
